armorSets.description: Drake Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Drake Knight Set is a black iron set worn by the unmet drake knights. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: You can find the Drake Knight Set in Crumbling Farum Azula. Map Link Go to the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace. From there, drop down to where the elevator shaft containing a waiting Warhawk is located (there is another Warhawk nearby, feasting on a corpse). After climbing down the nearby ladder, turn left and then face north. From here, drop onto a floating rock, and then again down to a platform on which you find the same elevator shaft from above.

armorSets.name: Elden Lord Set
armorSets.description: Elden Lord Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Elden Lord Set is a Lightweight armor that provide light magical and moderate Physical defense. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: Available from Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord and Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

armorSets.name: Fire Knight Set
armorSets.description: Fire Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is a brand new Armor Set in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. The helm of this set offers good buff to max Health, Stamina and equip load, making this set suitable for tank builds.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Drop by Fire Knights in the Shadow Keep

armorSets.name: Fire Prelate Set
armorSets.description: Fire Prelate Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Fire Prelate Set is a rather heavy armor set, but offers good defences, particularly against Fire. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: The full set is dropped by Fire Prelate enemies. Map Link The full set with the non-altered armor is dropped by the Fire Prelate in front of the Guardian's Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants. The Fire Prelate Armor (Altered) is dropped by the Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, Mt. Gelmir.

armorSets.name: Freyja's Set
armorSets.description: Freyja's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is a brand new Armor Set in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Freyja's Set appears wherever Redmane Freyja dies: If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Set on her body after beating her in the Leda and Allies Boss fight Map Link Otherwise, you can find it by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after beating the Leda and Allies Boss fight

armorSets.name: Gaius's Set
armorSets.description: Gaius's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is a brand new Armor Set in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. This armor set is great for heavy weight tank builds.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) The helm, armor, and gauntlets can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Gaius. The Wolf Rider Enemy drops Gaius's Greaves. See

armorSets.name: Gelmir Knight Set
armorSets.description: Gelmir Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Gelmir Knight Set an Armor piece set that still has not lost its luster. It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from loft ambition into gluttonous depravity. As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: You can loot the entire Gelmir Knight Set in the Gelmir Hero's Grave dungeon from a Gelmir Knight corpse. See it on the. To find the corpse, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look for a small window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder to find a Bloodhound Knight guarding the corpse.

armorSets.name: General Radahn Set
armorSets.description: General Radahn Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. General Radahn Set is a Heavyweight armor that boasts superior Robustness Resistance. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: Purchased from Enia at Roundtable Hold for 36,000 runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

armorSets.name: Godrick Knight Set
armorSets.description: Godrick Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Godrick Knight Set is a Light Weight armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick The Grafted. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: There's a chance the Godrick Knight Set is dropped by defeating a Godrick Knight. You can find these at: Gatefront Ruins: Dropped by the heavy Godrick Knight patrolling the outpost. Fort Haight: Chance to drop from the Godrick Knight atop the fort walls (one time). Stormhill: Two Godrick Knights can be found, one in a camp near Warmaster's Shack site of grace and the other on a nearby cliff.

armorSets.name: Godskin Apostle Set
armorSets.description: Godskin Apostle Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It provides minimal physical and magic damage negation and minimal resistance. The armor is lightweight and will total 10.9 meaning it can be used to achieve a light load on any build. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: The Godskin Apostle boss is at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid. The tower is found on the northern coast of Caelid midway between the two jutting out sections of land. The tower is relatively straightforward to complete, but the enemies can be tough to kill. Luckily, it is possible to complete almost the entire dungeon by simply running past the enemies.

armorSets.name: Haligtree Knight Set
armorSets.description: Haligtree Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Haligtree Knight Set is a medium heavy armor set that increases faith. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: The Haligtree Knight Helm can be looted from a corpse located near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace. It is found on a platform overlooking the site of grace, and can be reached by climbing a ladder near the grace. The remaining pieces of the Haligtree Knight Set have a chance to drop from any Haligtree Knight, which can be found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Two knights can be found immediately outside the room with the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, standing on either side of the entryway. The Erdtree Avatar standing between them does not respawn.

armorSets.name: Hornsent Set
armorSets.description: Hornsent Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is a brand new Armor Set in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. This armor set offers great resistance, especially focus. Suitable for most light weight builds.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Hornsent Set is dropped by Hornsent wherever he's killed, which can be: If you summoned him to fight Messmer the Impaler, he will drop Hornsent Set after invading you near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace Map Link If you choose to assist Leda and invade Hornsent in Shadow Keep, he will drop Hornsent Set once defeated Otherwise, you can find Hornsent Set on his corpse after fighting him as part of the Leda and Allies Boss fight

armorSets.name: Hoslow's Set
armorSets.description: Hoslow's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Hoslow's Set isaGarish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family. When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused. "I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion." Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: Dropped by Juno Hoslow along with Hoslow's Petal Whip as part of the final contract for the Volcano Manor Questline. Juno Hoslow is a Hostile NPC that you can invade after progressing through the questline. His invade rune be found in the northern Mountaintops of the Giants, east of Shack of the Lofty. Completing Diallos's questline rewards the player with Diallos's Mask, an alternate headpiece missing the twin tails. Alternatively, he can be killed for the mask earlier, when found in Liurnia of the Lakes. Video Location

armorSets.name: Igon's Set
armorSets.description: Igon's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is a brand new Armor Set in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. This armor set is ideal for light weight builds with it's high resistance and decent damage negation.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Complete Igon's questline by summoning him and then defeating Bayle The Dread. Igon will drop his items at his previous location, just south-east of Foot of the Jagged Peak Map Link his body will have both Igon's Greatbow and Igon's set.

armorSets.name: Jar
armorSets.description: Jar is a Helm in Elden Ring. Jar is a unique piece of armor that is awarded to the player by Iron Fist Alexander. Jar protect the player's head by applying various defensive properties, it also changes the appearance as well when it is equipped. Some armor pieces may be available to both genders but may be slightly different for male and female characters. Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned. Made with pride by Iron Fist Alexander.

pieces.name: Jar
pieces.location: Given to the player by Iron Fist Alexander. Follow his questline until you find him in Mt. Gelmir near Seethewater Terminus. Map Link Completing his dialogue here will award the player with the Jar. Map Link

armorSets.notes: Single helm, not a full set (from Iron Fist Alexander's questline). Used by builds: Frost + Bleed Dual Katana ('Let Me Solo Her').
armorSets.location: Given to the player by Iron Fist Alexander. Follow his questline until you find him in Mt. Gelmir near Seethewater Terminus. Map Link Completing his dialogue here will award the player with the Jar. Map Link

armorSets.name: Leyndell Knight Set
armorSets.description: Leyndell Knight Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Leyndell Knight Set is kind of the golden armor from knights that ara around the Leyndell, Royal Capital, that strikes a good balance between Physical and Magical defense. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: Pieces of the Leyndell Knight Armot Set have a chance to drop from any Leyndell Knight. One can be found just south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. Two knights can be found near the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau. One with a Greatbow on a platform to the east. Another on horseback patrolling the road to the southwest. The knight with the Greatbow can be farmed quickly. Many knights can be found in Leyndell Royal Capital. Near the end of the main story, certain events make much of the royal capital inaccessible, and knights will no longer spawn within the city. However, they will continue to spawn outside of Leyndell.

armorSets.name: Lionel's Set
armorSets.description: Lionel's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Lionel's Set This set was worn by Lionel the Lionhearted. When this chivalrous dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.
armorSets.location: Found on the bed in the building with the Lower Capital Church grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. See it on the. Video Location IMPORTANT: Make sure to collect it before advancing the story to the point where Leyndell becomes the Ashen Capital. If you burn the Erdtree and progress to the Ashen Capital, you can no longer obtain Lionel's Set if you haven't picked it up earlier.

armorSets.name: Lusat's Set
armorSets.description: Lusat's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are usually composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. Lusat's Set features prominent dark brilliant blue glintstones on the shoulders attached to a ragged silk cloak, and a huge blue orb atop the crown.

Then head north and turn east through a bunch of slimes to find the mausoleum.

To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.
